The archived KDK XAR TOC signatures verify offline through Apple's Software Update certificate chain to the Apple root certificate, with a rejected corrupted-signature negative control; revocation and Gatekeeper assessment were not performed. Selected Payload and PackageInfo bytes match their signed TOC lengths and digests: Payload SHA-256 09da4c267d832e378d459ccdfa244aaa4abd368d03a4edc74678248cdeea9346 (25G83) and ba7d555cbf3d77bc350741b5542b919ce6e52056f493785ba04129162e1e70a6 (24G830). No checksum requirement was waived. Kernel extraction, exact-build kernel-transition correspondence, and userspace library UUID evidence remain open. Steward adjudication of this component is pending, and product integration stays held.

items.rationale: Both points clarify shipped behavior at the detector-authoring and removal-audit boundary that watcher-cli-ux owns.
